name: Unbind
body:
School universal [void]; Level psychic 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

Casting Time 1 standard action or immediate action (see text)

Components V, S, DF

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target one spellcaster

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

Void: Spells with this descriptor are tied with a philosophical school of magic based on a concept known as the Void. The school teaches that the Void is the nothingness from which springs forth creativity, insight, spirit, thought, and also the source of pure energy from which all elements and phenomena are derived. Channeling the power of the Void (or the Void element) allows for the manipulation of the elements in objects and creatures, among other possibilities. Spells with the void descriptor are considered to belong to the Void element (for geomancers) and the void elemental school (for void elementalists).

If a spell has the [void] descriptor, it cannot be dispelled by elements release regardless of how high is your CL.

You alter the Void within a spellcaster’s spell to disrupt it from being successfully cast, similar to casting dispel magic. Unbind is cast as part of a readied action to counterspell. You automatically counterspell one spell of 2nd-level or lower that you successfully identified with a Spellcraft check. Alternatively, you can cast unbind as an immediate action.

During your counterspell attempt with unbind, the caster of the spell being counterspelled may expend a number of ki points equal to the level of their spell to prevent that spell from being counterspelled by you through this spell. You may expend 2 ki points to negate the caster’s attempt to cancel your counterspell action with this spell.
